title: AI-Powered Offline Learning for Higher Education in Crisis Zones
summary: Al-Aqsa University describes a low-power, offline learning system for crisis settings. Learning continuity and instructor workload benefits remain expected.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Al-Aqsa University is developing a low-power, offline learning system for crisis settings and seeking partners to expand it. Learning continuity and instructor workload benefits remain expected.
purpose: Sustain university teaching when internet access and electricity are unreliable.

ratings.reason: Students in crisis settings are intended to retain access to learning during outages.
Al-Aqsa University and instructors are intended to sustain teaching and automate assessment; no observed service result is supplied.

ai_role.statement: The project account does not separately evaluate AI’s contribution to the benefit.

evidence.citation: Project account in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. Outcomes are reported by the project team. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use case -4: AI-Powered Offline Learning for Higher Education in Crisis Zones

produced_by: Conditions that could produce the benefit are unspecified.
